posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
I know of a plugin that will help if you want the "Fight" and "Escape" menu in combat to say "Fight", "Escape" and "Chat". It is the NinJapon "CommonEventPartyComandsV3". Haven't got a link, so you will have to search or Google for it.
At one time I experimented with letting the party surrender to some enemies under certain circumstances. I discarded that mechanism as I thought that it didn't improve the game. Not used the plugin for a while, and I haven't kept anything that used "Surrender".

posts.author: alasth
posts.body:
The simplest and cleanest way if you want to be able to talk, and be able to say particular things in certain fights would be:
1) create a “talk” skill type
2) create a skill for each type of dialogue you want (for example: provoke/apologize/negotiate/etc...)
3) make each skill call a common event in which you'll put all your dialogue effects.
Now, you'll want to make sure that certain dialogues are only available in certain fights (would apologizing to a wild beast be weird?):
4) In the troops page, you create an event that starts at the beginning of the fight and unlocks the skill type "talk" and the skill in question (for example, when you fight bandits, you unlock the skill “negotiate”, which allows you to give your gold coins to finish the fight directly) and you remove the skill once the fight is over.
I could see something like that, and no need for a plugin.
